about: Every xterm.js member wmux uses (non-test src/renderer at the wt-wmux-base checkout, @xterm/xterm 6.1.0-beta.336 and its addons) and its status in the Rust front end (crates/oxtty-web). Restored from 0510a7d, where the TypeScript front end reached the old statuses; reasons still describe that front end until each member is redone. An entry whose name is not an API member (DOM, internals, prose) carries `exercisedBy`, a regular expression some test must match, before it may be `supported` (api-checklist.test.mjs).

statuses.todo: Supported by the TypeScript front end at 0510a7d; not yet in the Rust front end.
statuses.unsupported: Not planned; the reason says what replaces it.

init.reason: Re-exported from oxtty/xterm; `await init()` once is the only extra step, constructing before it throws.

options.cols.reason: Init-only, like xterm.js; change with resize().

options.rows.reason: Init-only, like xterm.js; change with resize().

options.scrollback.reason: Constructor only: the engine fixes it at creation, a runtime change throws (wmux only reads it).

options.fontSize.reason: Renderer option, get/set at runtime; fires onDimensionsChange when the cell changes.

options.theme.reason: Renderer option; also pushed to the engine (setColors) so OSC 4/10/11/12 queries answer the real colours.

options.scrollbar.reason: Only the width the fit keeps free (xterm.js 14px default); no scrollbar is drawn yet.

options.allowProposedApi.reason: Accepted, no effect: there is no proposed-API gate.

options.scrollOnUserInput.reason: Keys, IME and paste scroll a scrolled-back view to the bottom (xterm.js default true; wmux passes false).

options.disableStdin.reason: Drops keys, pastes and replies to the program like xterm.js; the textarea turns read-only.

options.altClickMovesCursor.reason: Alt+click sends arrow keys to the clicked cell (xterm.js 6.1 moveToCellSequence).

options.vtExtensions.kittyKeyboard.reason: Turns the engine's kitty protocol on (setKittyKeyboard); keys go through the copied xterm.js 6.1 kitty encoder with the flags of the last frame. Turning it off drops the pushed flags.

options.vtExtensions.colorSchemeQuery.reason: wmux turns it off for headless parity; the engine has no colour-scheme query reply.

options.vtExtensions.kittySgrBoldFaintCo.reason: wmux turns it off for headless parity; the engine follows xterm.js with it off.

options.macOptionClickForcesSelection.reason: Option+click is not reported to the program and selects (xterm.js SelectionService.shouldForceSelection).

options.windowsPty.reason: xterm.js ConPTY heuristics; needs a decision for the Windows build.

options.convertEol.reason: Always false (wmux passes false); omit it.

options.windowOptions.reason: The engine answers no window operations; wmux only saves and restores it around the image addon.

Terminal.open.reason: Builds div.terminal.xterm > div.xterm-screen > (div.xterm-helpers, canvas); a second open moves the element.

Terminal.write.reason: Strings and Uint8Array, callback after parse, write("", cb) as a parse barrier; time-sliced like xterm.js.

Terminal.resize.reason: Fires onResize; no-op for the same size.

Terminal.reset.reason: RIS applied at once (clears scrollback, like xterm.js reset).

Terminal.refresh.reason: Marks the rows for the next frame.

Terminal.dispose.reason: Drops pending writes and timers, disposes addons, renderer and engine.

Terminal.loadAddon.reason: Fit addons are activated; webgl and unicode11 are absorbed; anything else throws.

Terminal.modes.reason: From engine mode bits, X10 mouse included. reverseWraparoundMode and win32InputMode are always false.

Terminal.unicode.activeVersion.reason: Always "11" (engine tables); setting another version throws.

Terminal.textarea.reason: The hidden textarea in .xterm-helpers, set by open().

Terminal.attachCustomKeyEventHandler.reason: Sees every keydown, keypress and keyup first; false stops the key (the copied xterm.js arbitration).

Terminal.getSelection.reason: xterm.js SelectionService.selectionText: wrapped rows joined, wide characters once. Typed trailing spaces are dropped like erased cells (the engine does not tell them apart).

Terminal.select.reason: xterm.js SelectionService.setSelection; does nothing before open() (xterm.js throws).

Terminal.parser.registerOscHandler.reason: Needs an engine hook. OSC 52 is covered by the clipboard option; OSC 133/7792 and the viewer OSC 4/10/11/12 handlers are not.

Terminal.parser.registerCsiHandler.reason: Needs an engine hook (replyParity, shellPromptModeReset, viewerParser).

Terminal.registerMarker.reason: Markers need line tracking through scrollback trimming.

Terminal.onData.reason: Engine replies after every write drain (no frame needed); input from step 2.

Terminal.onBinary.reason: Fired by default-encoding mouse reports, never by output.

Terminal.onScroll.reason: Fires when buffer.active.viewportY changes (scroll calls, output, resize).

Terminal.onCursorMove.reason: Checked after each write drain, scroll and resize.

Terminal.onBell.reason: Once per BEL after each write drain.

Terminal.onDimensionsChange.reason: Font option changes and renderer-reported changes (late fonts, devicePixelRatio).

Terminal.onSelectionChange.reason: Fires where xterm.js fires: mouse up, API calls, and clears by user input, resize or an alternate screen switch (not when trimming moves or drops it, like xterm.js).

buffer.onBufferChange.reason: Fires when the alternate screen is entered or left.

buffer.active.getLine.reason: A copy of the line at call time (xterm.js returns a live view).

IBufferLine.translateToString.reason: Matches xterm.js except that trimRight also drops trailing typed spaces (the engine does not tell them from erased cells).

IBufferLine.isWrapped.reason: xterm.js meaning: continues the previous line.

IBufferLine.getCell.reason: The reuse argument is accepted and ignored.

FitAddon.fit.reason: Built-in FitAddon export, and @xterm/addon-fit 0.12 works as is (it reads only public members).

FitAddon subclass (FixedGeometryFitAddon.reason: super.fit/proposeDimensions work; its _core._renderService.dimensions read moves to terminal.dimensions.

WebglAddon (load).reason: Absorbed: the WebGL renderer is built in, the addon is never activated.

WebglAddon.onContextLoss.reason: Absorbed; never fires because the renderer restores a lost context itself.

WebglAddon.dispose.reason: Absorbed; no-op (there is no DOM renderer to fall back to).

Unicode11Addon (load).reason: Absorbed: activate() is run against a stand-in that only has unicode.register and must register version 11.

SearchAddon.findNext/findPrevious/clearD.reason: Search moves into the engine; loadAddon throws until then.

SerializeAddon.serialize.reason: loadAddon throws; Terminal.ansiSnapshot() (engine) replaces it. coldFrame's scrollback:0 + excludeModes variant needs an engine option (later).

WebLinksAddon.reason: Links step (OSC 8 + regex detection); loadAddon throws until then.

_core._charSizeService.measure/onCharSiz.reason: Use onDimensionsChange; a loaded fit addon refits by itself (charSizeRefit goes away).

_core._renderService.setRenderer/handleR.reason: webglTeardown: there is no DOM renderer fallback; the WebGL renderer restores its context.

_core.coreService.kittyKeyboard.reason: oxtty API: xtermKittyFlags(term) becomes term.kittyKeyboardFlags (the flags the encoder uses, from the last frame) and resetXtermKitty(term) becomes term.resetKittyKeyboard() (both screens, applied at once). Resetting in stream order at OSC 133;A still needs registerOscHandler (later).

_core.coreService.onUserInput.reason: oxtty API: term.onUserInput fires just before onData for keys, IME and paste, never for replies to the program; userInputGate subscribes to it instead.

_core._compositionHelper.reason: deadInputWatchdog reads _isComposing/_isSendingComposition only for a log line and logs '?' without them; the copied CompositionHelper stays internal.

WebglAddon._renderer._gl.reason: Context loss is handled inside the renderer.

WebglAddon._renderer._charAtlas.reason: Atlas health checks belong inside the renderer (atlasGuard goes away).

DOM .xterm-screen.reason: Holds the canvas, sized to it.

DOM .xterm-helpers.reason: Holds the textarea and the composition view.

DOM .xterm-helper-textarea.reason: Built like xterm.js (class, aria and autocomplete attributes, tabindex 0) and moved to the cursor cell after each frame.

DOM .composition-view.reason: The copied CompositionHelper fills it while composing and places it at the cursor (style.left/top).

CSS @xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css.reason: open() injects its own styles; drop the import.

Element reparenting (park and re-append).reason: The element can be moved; open() again also moves it.

Synthetic mouse events on .xterm-screen.reason: Mouse reports and selection both listen on the element, so dispatched events (plainDragSelect replays) select and report like real ones.
